title: Method and code
intro: This page describes the methods behind the research pages and provides the code we used, so you can repeat the analyses with your own data. All files are in our GitHub repository.

useCases.title: NDVI time series for your location
Tipping point analysis for your own location
steps: Download the Earth Engine script and open it in the Earth Engine Code Editor.
Change the coordinates at the top of the script to your location, run it, and export the NDVI time series as CSV.
Download the early warning signals notebook, open it in VS Code, and set the path to your CSV.
Run all cells: you get the early warning signals, Kendall's tau and the tipping point scenario for your location.
